correctness.rationale: The morphism mu:0->01,1->10 has all four bigram types inside mu^3(0); any factor of length L<=256 of the infinite fixed point crosses at most two 256-blocks mu^8(ab) and occurs in mu^11(0) of length 2048. For k=3..10 and proposed r=(5,7,9,11,11,11,13,13), max kr=130. Independently enumerating ALL distinct factors of length kr in that prefix, every factor supports at least one allowed m<=r, with exact counts 44,86,144,196,240,284,360,388. Actual lower witnesses j=(0,16,16,10,0,0,64,53) reject every m<r by parity digit sums. Thus all starting positions, not just sampled positions, satisfy matching bounds.

limitations: No inference about k>10, arbitrary aperiodic words, or an optimal asymptotic constant; proof of infinite starts relies on the explicit length-256 factor lemma.
